summary: Contestants research and create a multimedia presentation on how collaboration accelerates pediatric cancer research. They present their findings to judges, analyze challenges, evaluate partnerships, and recommend strategies to improve collaboration and develop new therapies for children with cancer.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No less than seven (7) and no more than ten (10) minutes for oral presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
submission_requirements: One (1) copy of the signed BPA Release Form(s), Works Cited, Fair Use Guidelines and AI Usage and Documentation Form for each round of the competition (preliminaries and finals)
No materials, other than the required submission materials, may be left with judges
Contestant ID is required for all submissions. Materials from non-registered contestants and/or those missing Contestant ID cannot be accepted
The contestant is responsible for securing a signed BPA Release Form(s) from any person, including oneself, whose image or work is used in the project
The contestant is responsible for citing all sources, including oneself, on the Works Cited page for any work used on the project
Materials must follow the organization’s BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
what_to_bring: One single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for their presentation
competencies: Conduct comprehensive research using diverse resources and communicate findings through professional reports and presentations, responding to questions with evidence-based reasoning
Design and deliver engaging multimedia presentations using advanced digital tools and cloud-based platforms
Demonstrate effective communication skills while presenting a multimedia presentation

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 2 Permitted with Citation
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the contestant and must take place within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, contestants may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Finals may be part of the competition
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
PRESENTATION WILL BE STOPPED AT TEN (10) MINUTES
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this judged event
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
